instruction: Write an XDP program that must set interactive real-time QoS class AF42 (TOS 0x90) with L3 checksum fixup. Forward all packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Validate Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
Overwrite IPv4 header ip->tos with value 144
Recalculate IPv4 header checksum ip->check over all 20 bytes
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration

tests.name: pass_arp
tests.description: Non-IP ARP frame passed without alteration
